title: Align configurable messaging table names with DDL
summary: Make messaging migrations and runtime use the same configured outbox/inbox table names.
why:
EA04 proves a non-default configuration migrates default tables while runtime queries
custom names, producing a deterministic production failure.

include:
two new P5 migrations; safe identifier handling for their raw indexes; PG
custom-name witness; CHANGELOG and receipt.
exclude:
changing columns or indexes semantically; existing frozen tables; renaming
default tables; down migrations; unrelated Config accessors; applying DDL to any non-test database.
